mapper.sql: C.CUST_ID, C.CUST_NM, C.BIZ_NO, C.CEO_NM, C.ADDR, C.ADDR_DTL, C.TEL_NO, C.CUST_GRADE, C.CREDIT_STATUS, C.CREDIT_LIMIT, C.CHARGE_USER_ID, C.LAST_NOTICE_DT, C.USE_YN, C.REG_USER_ID, C.REG_DT, C.UPD_DT
mapper.select: SELECT CONTACT_ID, CUST_ID, CONTACT_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, EMAIL, MOBILE_NO, MAIN_YN FROM TB_CUST_CONTACT WHERE CUST_ID = #{custId} ORDER BY MAIN_YN DESC, CONTACT_ID
SELECT CONTACT_NM, EMAIL FROM TB_CUST_CONTACT WHERE CUST_ID = #{custId} AND EMAIL IS NOT NULL ORDER BY MAIN_YN DESC, CONTACT_ID LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CUSTOMER ( CUST_ID, CUST_NM, BIZ_NO, CEO_NM, ADDR, ADDR_DTL, TEL_NO, CUST_GRADE, CREDIT_STATUS, CREDIT_LIMIT, CHARGE_USER_ID, USE_YN, REG_USER_ID, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{custId}, #{custNm}, #{bizNo}, #{ceoNm}, #{addr}, #{addrDtl}, #{telNo}, #{custGrade}, '01', #{creditLimit}, #{chargeUserId}, 'Y', #{regUserId}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO TB_CUST_CONTACT (CUST_ID, CONTACT_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, EMAIL, MOBILE_NO, MAIN_YN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{custId}, #{contactNm}, #{deptNm}, #{positionNm}, #{email}, #{mobileNo}, #{mainYn}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_CUSTOMER SET CREDIT_STATUS = #{creditStatus}, UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE CUST_ID = #{custId}
UPDATE TB_CUSTOMER SET USE_YN = 'N', UPD_DT = NOW() WHERE CUST_ID = #{custId}
